body.reason: The bucket policy aws_s3_bucket_policy.opal_data_49financial in the owner file denies s3:* to every principal outside the -49f- role pattern and the registry exemptions, and gateway-schwab-catalog-read-role is outside both, so the catalog reader identity grant cannot reach the state object by itself. The policy is not edited here: it is outside this order, and BLOCKING row NFRA_OPLGTW-Z-W179-S1 routes it to the issuer.
